Subject: Renewal window + capacity increase — what procurement needs

Hi Karthik,

Quick note — our renewal for Redwood (contract #DL-2397) comes up mid-December. We are planning a 2x capacity uplift and would like to get procurement aligned early so we don't hit the usual paperwork delay. Two asks from our side:

1) What exact artifacts do you need from ZenHealth to trigger vendor re-onboarding in our procurement portal?
2) Do you have a templated PO and SOW addendum we can start with so our legal can review in parallel?

We have a procurement intake window Nov 8–22 that we want to take advantage of, otherwise approvals will push past the renewal. Attaching the initial vendor questionnaire the procurement team filled for context.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call this week.

Cheers,
Ava Simmons
Procurement Lead, ZenHealth
ava.simmons@zenhealth.com

Ava — thanks for the heads up and the questionnaire. Short plan below so procurement and legal have clarity: 

- Required customer artifacts: confirmed billing contact, signed SOW addendum (term change + capacity table), PO or PO intent, and vendor questionnaire updates (if any controls changed).
- We can provide: updated SOW addendum (SOW_v2), a templated PO spreadsheet you can drop into your procurement portal, and a short evidence checklist for uploads.
- Preferred flow to hit your Nov 8–22 window:
  1) I send SOW_v2 + pricing spreadsheet by 10/22.
  2) ZenHealth confirms billing contact + returns PO intent by 10/30.
  3) Marissa will upload evidence to our shared drive and raise the legal handoff immediately when PO intent is received.

I'm attaching a quick pricing workbook so you can confirm quantities. If your procurement portal requires a specific field mapping, send an export and Marissa will map it.

Let me know if you want to run a 20-minute alignment call tomorrow.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi Ava — looping in the procurement steps we need to complete on our side. Karthik, flagging that legal should be on the SOW review early.

Procurement checklist (required for portal submission):
- Signed SOW addendum (term + SKU table)
- Official PO or PO intent (PDF)
- Vendor risk questionnaire (latest)
- Contact list for billing and security reviews (name, title, email)
- Any required COIs or SOC evidence (if procurement requests)

Upload link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/zenhealth/procure-evidence-checklist

If ZenHealth's portal requires attachments in a specific order, include the signed SOW first, then PO, then questionnaire. Our Procurement Ops SLA for uploads is 3 business days once we receive PO intent.

Attached is a one-page evidence checklist you can hand to your procurement vendor contact. Once you confirm the billing contact, I'll create the HubSpot procurement task and share the PO template.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
